qe: In which region is 'Shifting Cultivation' (Jhuming) traditionally practiced in India?
qh: भारत में पारंपरिक रूप से 'स्थानांतरी कृषि' (झूमिंग) किस क्षेत्र में की जाती है?
e: Concept: 'Shifting cultivation' (jhoom kheti) me kisan jungle ka ek tukda kaat kar jala deta hai, uss raakh me kuch saal anaj ugata hai, aur paidavar ghatne par doosri jagah chala jata hai - zameen ko aaram dene ke liye. Bharat me ise North-East ke rajyaon (Assam ke pahaadi hisse, Meghalaya, Nagaland, Mizoram) me 'Jhuming' kehte hain; duniya me milpa, ladang, conuco jaise naam hain. Isliye 'Jhuming' = NE India wali shifting cultivation. Exam point: 'Jhuming = shifting cultivation (NE India)'.

qe: What are 'Fazendas' in the context of Brazilian agriculture?
qh: ब्राजील की कृषि के संदर्भ में 'फजेंडा' (Fazendas) क्या हैं?
e: Concept: Brazil me Portuguese bhasha me bade kheti ke estate ko 'Fazenda' kehte hain. 19th-20th sadi me Brazil (jaise Sao Paulo ke aas-paas) me 'fazendas' wahi bade coffee plantation the jahan hazaaron mazdoor coffee ke beej (beans) chunne ka kaam karte the. Isliye Brazil me Fazendas = badi coffee ki kheti wali jagah. Aaj bhi bade cattle ranch/Fazendas likha jata hai, par exam me mukhya tarike se coffee plantation ke liye poochha jata hai. Exam point: 'Fazendas = Brazil ke bade coffee plantation'.

qe: Collective farming, also known as 'Kolkhoz', was introduced in which former country?
qh: सामूहिक कृषि, जिसे 'कोल्खोज़' (Kolkhoz) भी कहा जाता है, किस पूर्व देश में शुरू की गई थी?
e: Concept: Kolkhoz ek Russian shabd hai jo Soviet Union (USSR) ke samkaleen (collective) farm ke liye use hota tha - isme kai kisanon ki zameen ek ho jati thi aur sab milkar (samaaj/tathe) kheti karte the, paidavar ka hissa sarkar tay karti thi. Ye 1929 ke baad Stalin ne lagu kiya. Isliye 'Kolkhoz' ka sambandh USSR se hai (Sovkhoz sarkari farm hota tha - dono me farq). India me 'cooperative farming' me zameen apne paas rehti hai, ye usse alag hai. Exam point: 'Kolkhoz = USSR ka collective farm'.

qe: The 'Prairies' in North America are famous for which grain production?
qh: उत्तर अमेरिका में 'प्रेयरी' (Prairies) किस अनाज उत्पादन के लिए प्रसिद्ध हैं?
e: Concept: North America ke 'Prairies' (hazard, ghans ke bade maidan) me sanyantrik (machine se) wheat ki kheti hoti hai - yahi duniya ka 'granary' (anaj ka bhandaar) kehlata hai. Wahan kaali, upjau mitti, samtal zameen aur bade farms hone ke kaaran tractor-combine se kam mehnat me hazaaron tonne gehun paida hota hai. Isliye Prairies ka mukhya paidaan 'wheat' hai (makka, chawal ya kapas nahi). Canada ke 'spring wheat' bhi isi ilake ke hain. Exam point: 'Prairies = wheat (gehun) ka ilaka'.

qe: Where is the 'Siberian Shelf' and why is it unique?
qh: 'साइबेरियन शेल्फ' कहाँ है और यह अद्वितीय क्यों है?
o: In the Arctic Ocean; the widest continental shelf in the world
In the Pacific; an active trench
e: Concept: Arctic Ocean me Siberia ke uttar ka hissa Continental Shelf hai (samasatal samudri tah jahan samundar uthli hai). Iski khaas baat ye hai ki ye duniya ka SABSE CHAURA (widest) continental shelf hai - lagbhag 1500 km+ chaura, kyunki wahan mahasagar ne zameen ka bada hissa duba diya hai. Iska tel-gas ke liye mahatva hai. Isliye sawal me 'Siberian Shelf' ko Arctic Ocean aur sabse chaura shelf kaha jayega. Exam point: 'Siberian Shelf = Arctic Ocean, duniya ka sabse chaura continental shelf'.

qe: The 'Ring of Fire' is a zone of intense activity in which ocean?
qh: 'रिंग ऑफ फायर' किस महासागर में तीव्र गतिविधि का क्षेत्र है?
e: Concept: 'Ring of Fire' ek ghode ke nave (horseshoe) jaisa belt hai jo Pacific Ocean ke chaaron taraf faila hua hai. Yahan tectonic plates ek doosre ke neeche sarakti hain (subduction), jiski wajah se duniya ke lagbhag 90% bhukamp (earthquakes) aur 75% jaalamukhi (volcano) isi belt me aate hain - Japan, Indonesia, California, Chile sab isi par hain. Isliye Ring of Fire Pacific Ocean ka zone hai, Atlantic ka nahi. Exam point: 'Ring of Fire = Pacific Ocean me (maximum earthquake + volcano)'.

qe: The 'Standard Meridian' of India passes through which city primarily?
qh: IST के लिए मानक याम्योत्तर मुख्य रूप से किस शहर से गुजरता है?
e: Concept: India ka 'Standard Meridian' 82 degree30' E (82.5 degree East) hai, aur ye longitude lagbhag Uttar Pradesh ke Mirzapur ke paas se guzarta hai (Allahabad ke qareeb bhi). Isi meridian ke local time ko poore desh ka 'Indian Standard Time' (IST) maana jata hai. Iska fayda hai ki Kolkata se Gujarat tak sab ghadiyan ek hi samay dikhati hain. 82.5 degreeE ka matlab hai GMT se 5 ghante 30 minute aage. Exam point: 'Standard Meridian 82.5 degreeE, Mirzapur (UP) ke paas se guzarta hai'.

qe: Where is the 'Mariana Trench' located?
qh: 'मारियाना ट्रेंच' कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Concept: 'Mariana Trench' duniya ki sabse gehri jagah hai - iski gehrai lagbhag 11,000 metre (Challenger Deep ~10,994 m) hai, jahan Mount Everest bhi doob jaye. Ye Pacific Ocean me Japan ke qareeb (Mariana Islands) me located hai, kyunki yahan do plates (Pacific me pacific plate) ke milan par gehri khayi bani. Atlantic, Indian ya Arctic me itni gehri trench nahi hai. Exam point: 'Mariana Trench = Pacific Ocean (duniya ka sabse gehra bindu)'.

qe: In which region is the 'Red Sea' forming due to tectonic rifting?
qh: 'लाल सागर' किस क्षेत्र में दरार (Rifting) के कारण बन रहा है?
e: Concept: 'Red Sea' ek young (naya) samudra hai jo do tectonic plates - African (Nubian) plate aur Arabian plate - ke hatne (divergent/rifting) se ban raha hai. Isi rift valley me samudri paani bhar gaya hai, aur yahi wajah hai ki yahan peel (rift) wali khayi, bhukamp aur jaalamukhi (volcano) milte hain; ye samudra har saal kuch milimeter chaura hota ja raha hai. Isliye Red Sea ka sambandh East Africa ke rifting (East African Rift) aur Arabian plate se hai. Exam point: 'Red Sea = African aur Arabian plate ke rifting se bana'.

qe: Which element was confirmed on the Moon's surface by Chandrayaan-3's LIBS instrument?
qh: चंद्रयान-3 ने चंद्रमा की सतह पर किस तत्व की पुष्टि की?
e: Concept: Chandrayaan-3 ka LIBS (Laser Induced Breakdown Spectroscopy) ek aisa instrument hai jo laser se chingari maar kar satah par maujood tatvon ka spektra padhta hai. Isne chand ke dakshin dhruv (south pole) ke qareeb raeg (soil) me SULFUR (gandhak) ki upasthiti ki pushti ki - iske alawa aluminium, calcium, iron, chromium, titanium bhi mile. Sulfur ke milne ka matlab hai ki wahan aisi cheezein hain jo duniya par kam hi milti hain; isse chand ki geology samajhne me madad milegi. Exam point: 'Chandrayaan-3 (LIBS) ne chand par sulfur confirm kiya'.

qe: The 'Standard Meridian' of India is based on which longitude?
qh: भारत का मानक देशांतर ______ है।
e: Concept: Bharat ka Standard Time ek hi meridian par nahi, 82 degree30' E meridian par aadharit hai. Har 1 degree longitude ke liye samay me 4 minute ka farq aata hai, isliye 82.5 degree x 4 minute = 330 minute = 5 ghante 30 minute. Iska matlab GMT se IST = +5:30 hours, yaani jab London me dopahar 12 bajte hain to dilli/lucknow me shaam 5:30. Isi wajah se GMT me 5:30 jodkar Indian samay nikalte hain. Exam point: 'IST = GMT + 5:30 (82.5 degreeE par aadhaarit)'.

qe: Which animals are typically reared by nomadic herders in the 'Tundra' regions?
qh: 'टुंड्रा' क्षेत्रों में चलवासी पशुपालकों द्वारा आमतौर पर किन जानवरों को पाला जाता है?
e: Concept: Tundra (bahut thandi, barf se dhaki) region me kheti ho hi nahi sakti, isliye wahan ke log (jaise Siberia ke Sami/Evenki, Lapland ke Lapps) REINDEER (barren) chhote, isliye wahan ke log REINDEER (barren) chhote, isliye wahan ke log REINDEER (barren) paalte hain - in pashuon ko barf khod kar khaanewale liken (lichen) aur moss milte hain, aur inka doodh, mans, khaal sab kaam aata hai; sledge (gadi) bhi reindeer se khinte hain. Oont, llama ya bhed tundra ke nahi hain. Exam point: 'Tundra ke nomadic herders = reindeer (barren)'.

qe: In which continent are 'Llamas' and 'Alpacas' traditionally reared in the high-altitude Andes?
qh: किस महाद्वीप के ऊँचे एंडीज पर्वतों में पारंपरिक रूप से 'लामा' और 'अल्पाका' पाले जाते हैं?
e: Concept: Llamas aur Alpacas duniya ke sirf usi ilake me paalte hain jahan unka puraana ghar hai - South America ke ANDES pahaad (Peru, Bolivia, Chile, Ecuador) ke unche ilake. Ye oont (camel) family ke sadasya hain par chhote hain, aur wahan ke aadivasi (Inca sabhyata se) inhe gathari dhone, oon (wool) aur gaada (mans) ke liye paalte aaye hain. Africa ke oont ya Asia ke yak isse alag hain. Exam point: 'Llamas/Alpacas = South America ke Andes pahaad'.

qe: Which region is a major area for 'Nomadic Herding' across North Africa and Eurasia?
qh: उत्तर अफ्रीका और यूरेशिया में 'चलवासी पशुचारण' का प्रमुख क्षेत्र कौन सा है?
o: The belt from the Atlantic shores of North Africa to Mongolia and Central China
e: Concept: Nomadic herding (kabaili pashupalan) duniya me ek lambi patti (belt) me hoti hai jo Sahara/North Africa ke Atlantic kinare se shuru hoti hai aur Arabia, Iran, Central Asia (Kazakhstan) hote hue Mongolia aur China ke andar tak jaati hai - kyunki ye sab ilake sookhe, ghaas ke mamuli wale aur unchaai wale hain jahan kheti nahi hoti. Africa ke tropical jungle ya Europe ke samtal maidan isme nahi aate. Exam point: 'Nomadic herding belt = North Africa se Mongolia-Central China tak'.

qe: The 'Afar Triangle' is an example of a ______.
qh: 'अफार ट्रायंगल' (Afar Triangle) किसका एक उदाहरण है?
o: Triple Junction / Rifting area in East Africa
e: Concept: 'Afar Triangle' (Danakil Depression ke paas) ek aisi jagah hai jahan TEEN (three) tectonic plates ek doosre se milte hain aur alag ho rahe hain - isliye ise 'triple junction' kehte hain. Yahan dharti ki pardat patli hai, lakhon saal me samudra banega, aur yahan garam jal-raasayanik (hydrothermal) activity, jaalamukhi aur bhukamp bahut milte hain. Aisa triple junction duniya me kam hai, isliye ye geography me famous hai. Exam point: 'Afar Triangle = triple junction (rifting/plate hatne ka sthaan)'.

qe: The 'Afar Triangle' hotspot is located in which continent?
qh: 'अफार ट्रायंगल' हॉटस्पॉट किस महाद्वीप में स्थित है?
e: Concept: Afar Triangle Africa ke 'Horn of Africa' me hai - Ethiopia, Djibouti aur Eritrea ke ilake me, Red Sea aur Addis Ababa ke beech. Ye East African Rift system ka hissa hai jahan Africa ki zameen do hisson me foot (rift) rahi hai. Isliye iska mahadeep (continent) Africa hai. Iska sambandh Asia ya Europe se nahi, par iska research Africa me hota hai kyunki yahin dharti naye samudra ka janm dikha rahi hai. Exam point: 'Afar Triangle = Africa (Ethiopia-Djibouti region)'.

qe: According to the UNDP Human Development Report (2023-24), India's HDI rank is:
qh: नवीनतम यूएनडीपी रिपोर्ट के अनुसार, भारत की एचडीआई रैंक क्या है?
e: Concept: Human Development Report (HDR) 2023-24 ke muthabik Bharat ki HDI rank 134thi hai (193 deshon me), jiska score lagbhag 0.644 hai - matlab Bharat 'medium human development' wale deshon me aata hai. Iske aas-paas Bhutan, Bangladesh, Indonesia jaise desh hote hain. Rank upar jaane ke liye HDI ke teen hisse sudhrne chahiye: umar (life expectancy), shiksha (schooling) aur income. Ye number har saal ke HDR ke saath badalta hai. Exam point: 'India ki HDI rank (HDR 2023-24) = 134'.

qe: The 'Standard Meridian' of India is 82.5°E. What is the time difference from GMT?
qh: भारत का 'मानक याम्योत्तर' 82.5°E है। GMT से समय का अंतर क्या है?
e: Concept: India ka Standard Meridian 82.5 degreeE hai, aur IST (Indian Standard Time) ko GMT se jodne ka hisaab aise hota hai - pratyek 1 degree longitude ke liye 4 minute; 82.5 x 4 = 330 minute = 5 ghante 30 minute. Isliye IST = GMT + 5:30 hours, yaani London me subah 7 bajte hain to Bharat me dopahar 12:30 bajte hain. Ye duniya ke bade deshon me kam hai (Russia me 11 time zones hain). Exam point: 'IST = GMT + 5.5 ghante (5:30)'.

qe: In which region are tropical revolving storms known as 'Willy-Willies'?
qh: 'विली-विली' (Willy-Willies) कहाँ आते हैं?
e: Concept: Tropical cyclones (samudri toofan) har jagah ek jaise nahi kehlate - North-Western Australia me inhe 'Willy-Willies' kehte hain. Duniya bhar ke naam yaad rakhein: Pacific (China-Japan) me 'Typhoon', Atlantic/America me 'Hurricane', Indian Ocean me 'Cyclone', aur Australia ke aas-paas 'Willy-Willies'. Ye sab ek hi tarah ke toofan hain, sirf naam region ke hisaab se badalte hain. Exam point: 'Willy-Willies = North-West Australia ke tropical cyclone'.

qe: Where is 'Mawsynram' located?
qh: 'मौसिनराम' कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Concept: Mawsynram Meghalaya ke Khasi Hills me hai - ye duniya ka sabse zyada barish wala sthaan maana jata hai (average ~11,870 mm salana barish). Iski wajah hai monsoon ki garm aur bhaap se bharpoor hawaen jo Bangladesh ke maidanon se aakar Khasi pahaadon se takra kar upar uthti hain, thandi hokar ghani badli aur barish barsa deti hain - isi process ko 'orographic rainfall' kehte hain. Isliye Mawsynram Meghalaya me hai, cherrapunji ke paas. Exam point: 'Mawsynram = Meghalaya (duniya me sabse zyada barish)'.

qe: What was the national sex ratio in India according to Census 2011?
qh: 2011 की जनगणना के अनुसार भारत में लिंग अनुपात क्या था?
e: Concept: Census 2011 ke hisaab se Bharat ka sex ratio 943 tha - yaani prati 1000 purushon par 943 striyan. Ye 2001 (933) se thoda sudhra tha par abhi bhi 1000 se kam hai. Sabse kam ratio Haryana (879) aur sabse zyada Kerala (1084) me tha. Ye aankda ladkiyon ki sthiti samajhne ka aham maap hai; isi wajah se 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' jaise karyakram chalte hain. Exam point: 'Census 2011 sex ratio = 943 (1000 purush par)'. In vikalpon ka is prashn se seedha rishta nahi hai. Isliye sahi uttar 943 hi hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: The population pyramid of 'Japan' represents which demographic category?
qh: 'जापान' का जनसंख्या पिरामिड किस प्रकार का उदाहरण है?
e: Concept: Japan ki aabadi ki haram (pyramid) 'declining' ya urn jaisi hai - base patla (kyunki bacche kam paida hote hain) aur upar ka hissa chaura (buzurg zyada). Iska matlab hai janm dar bahut kam (replacement se neeche) aur umar lambi, isliye aabadi ghat rahi hai aur kaam karne wale log kam pad rahe hain. Aisi sthiti un deshon me hoti hai jahan shiksha, dhan aur family planning bahut aage badh chuke hain (Japan, Germany, Italy). Exam point: 'Japan = declining/urn-shaped pyramid (aging + ghatti aabadi)'.

qe: Which type of population pyramid characterizes 'Australia'?
qh: 'ऑस्ट्रेलिया' का जनसंख्या पिरामिड किस प्रकार का है?
e: Concept: Australia Australia ki aabadi ki shakal 'bell' (ghanti) jaisi hai - base na bahut chaura, na patla; beech me phoola hua. Iska matlab hai janm ki dar aur maut ki dar lagbhag barabar hain, isliye aabadi sthir (stable) hai. Aise deshon me bache paida to hote hain par sankhya sama rehti hai. Australia ke saath USA, Canada, New Zealand bhi isi shakal ke hain. Exam point: 'Australia = stable/bell-shaped population pyramid'.

qe: In 'Canada', agriculture is highly ______ and largely managed by male workers.
qh: 'कनाडा' में कृषि अत्यधिक ______ है और मुख्य रूप से पुरुषों द्वारा संभाली जाती है।
e: Concept: Canada jaise viksit deshon me kheti poori tarah yantrik (mechanised) ho chuki hai - bade tractor, combine harvester se kuch hi mazdooron me hazaaron acre sambhalte hain. Isi wajah se gaon me kaam karne wale kam ho gaye hain, aur jo bache hain wo aksar purush hote hain (bhaari machinery chalane wale), jabki sheher me service jobs me auratein zyada kaam karti hain. Isliye Canada ke gaon me mard aur sheher me zyada auratein dikhti hain. Exam point: 'Canada = highly mechanised agriculture (male workers)'.

qe: Which stage of the demographic transition model describes a country like 'Nigeria' (expanding pyramid)?
qh: 'नाइजीरिया' वर्तमान में जनसांख्यिकीय संक्रमण की किस अवस्था में है (बढ़ता हुआ पिरामिड)?
e: Concept: Demographic Transition Model (DTM) ke Stage 2 me koi desh aata hai jab uski janm dar (birth rate) abhi oonchi ho par maut dar (death rate) tezi se gir chuki ho - isse aabadi tezi se badhti hai. Nigeria aisa hi desh hai jahan har aurat se 5+ bachche paida hote hain aur aspatal/dawaiyan sasti mil jati hain, isliye aabadi 'expanding' (failti) pyramid jaisi lagti hai. India isse thoda aage tha. Exam point: 'Nigeria = Stage 2 (expanding population)'.

qe: Where is 'Mawsynram' and why is it globally renowned?
qh: 'मौसिनराम' क्यों प्रसिद्ध है?
o: Highest average annual rainfall on Earth
e: Concept: Mawsynram Meghalaya ke Khasi pahaadon me ek gaon hai jo duniya me sabse zyada barish ke liye famous hai - salana average lagbhag 11,870 mm (Bharat ke sheshi ilakon me 500-1000 mm). Iski wajah hai monsoon ki hawaen jo Bangladesh ke chale hue maidanon se aakar Khasi pahaadon se takra kar upar uthti hain aur thandi hone se ghani barish deti hain - isi ko orographic (pahaad wali) rainfall kehte hain. Exam point: 'Mawsynram = duniya ka sabse zyada barish wala sthaan (Meghalaya)'.

qe: Which city has one of the highest urban population densities in the world?
qh: विश्व में सर्वाधिक जनसंख्या घनत्व वाले शहरों में से एक कौन सा है?
e: Concept: 'Urban population density' me Manila (Philippines) duniya ke sabse ghane shehron me ginta hai (kuch hisson me 45,000+ log per square kilometre). Zyada density ka matlab hai kam jagah me bahut log, unche flats, traffic aur safai ki samasyaein. Mumbai bhi duniya ke sabse ghane shehron me aata hai (lagbhag 20,000+/km2) par Manila ki tanbeedh usse zyada maani jati hai. Isliye 'highest urban density' ke sawal me Manila aata hai. Exam point: 'Highest urban density wala shehr = Manila (Philippines)'.

qe: Which country overtook China to become the most populous nation in 2023 according to UN estimates?
qh: संयुक्त राष्ट्र के आंकड़ों के अनुसार कौन सा देश 2023 में विश्व का सबसे अधिक जनसंख्या वाला देश बना?
e: Concept: 2023 me United Nations ke andaze se Bharat duniya ka sabse zyada aabadi wala desh ban gaya, China se aage nikal gaya - dono ki aabadi 1.4 arab (1.4 billion) ke aas-paas thi. Bharat me aabadi tezi se badhne ki wajah hai young population aur dheere ghatti janm dar; China me 'one child' wali ghati janm dar ne aabadi gira di. Isliye 'most populous nation (2023)' = India. Exam point: '2023 me China se aage nikal kar sabse zyada aabadi wala desh = Bharat'.

qe: Which continent accommodates approximately 60% of the world's total human population?
qh: किस महाद्वीप में विश्व की कुल जनसंख्या का लगभग 60% हिस्सा निवास करता है?
e: Concept: Duniya ki kul aabadi ka lagbhag 60% hissa sirf ek mahadesh Asia me rehta hai (China, India, Indonesia, Pakistan, Bangladesh sab yahin hain), jabki Asia ka kshetrafal duniya ka sirf lagbhag 30% hai - isliye yahan ghanatv sabse zyada hai. Africa tez badh raha hai par abhi bhi ~18% par hai. Isiliye '60% population' wala jawab Asia hai. Exam point: 'Duniya ki ~60% aabadi = Asia me'. Yah teeno vikalp prashn ke mool bindu se hatt jaate hain. Is prashn ka theek jawab Asia hai. Is tathya ko nakshon tatha chitron ke saath dohrane par yaad lambi samay tak bani rehti hai.

qe: What is the primary 'Parent Rock' whose weathering yields Black Soil (Regur) in India?
qh: भारत में काली मिट्टी (रेगुर) के लिए 'जनक शैल' क्या है?
e: Concept: Bharat ke kaali mitti (black soil, jise 'regur' bhi kehte hain) ki asli jad (parent rock) BASALT lava hai - Deccan Traps ke phatte hue lava ke upar lambey samay ki weathering se ye mitti bani. Isi wajah se usme iron, aluminium, magnesium, lime, potash hote hain aur wo nami sokh kar rakhti hai (isliye cotton ke liye best hai). Granite ya sandstone se ye nahi banti; lava/volcanic rock se banti hai. Exam point: 'Black soil (regur) ka parent rock = basalt (Deccan lava)'.

qe: The catastrophic 'Mudflow' disaster in Leh (2010) was triggered by which weather event?
qh: लेह (2010) में 'मडफ्लो' आपदा किस घटना के कारण शुरू हुई थी?
e: Concept: 2010 me Leh (Ladakh) me achanak bhaari barish hui jise 'cloudburst' kehte hain - ek chhote ilake me 100 mm+ barish chand minute me; isse pahaadon ki mitti, kankar aur paani milkar tez 'mudflow' (keechad wali badh) ban gaya, jisne sheher me jaan-maar ka bada nuksaan kiya. Isliye Leh disaster ka kaaran cloudburst ke baad toofani barish tha, koi glacier ya bhukamp nahi. Exam point: 'Leh mudflow (2010) = cloudburst + torrential rain'.

qe: Earth reaches its closest point to the Sun (Perihelion) around which date?
qh: पृथ्वी सूर्य के सबसे करीब (पेरिहेलियन) लगभग किस तारीख को होती है?
e: Concept: Prithvi ki kaksha (orbit) poori tarah gol nahi balki dheergvritt (ellipse) hai, isliye ek saal me ek baar wo sooraj ke sabse qareeb hoti hai - ise 'Perihelion' kehte hain, jo lagbhag 3 January ko padta hai (doori ~147 million km). Sabse door wali sthit i 'Aphelion' (3-4 July, ~152 million km) kehlati hai. Iske kaaran mausam nahi badalte (wo tilt (axial tilt) se hote hain), par ye dates exam me poochhi jati hain. Exam point: 'Perihelion = 3 January (sooraj ke sabse qareeb)'.

qe: The 'Vindhya' and 'Satpura' ranges in central India are classified geologically as:
qh: भारत में 'विंध्य' और 'सतपुड़ा' श्रेणियां किस प्रकार के पर्वत हैं?
e: Concept: Bharat ke beech wale ilake me Vindhya aur Satpura do lambi pahaadiyan hain jo asal me 'block mountains' hain - yaani dharti ki parcham (crust) me bade faults (darar) ke saath kuch hisse upar uth gaye aur kuch neeche dhas gaye; upar uthne wala hissa block mountain kehlata hai. Himalaya 'fold mountains' hain (plate takrane se jhukkar bane), ghats 'residual' hain. Vindhya-Satpura beech me bani honi ke kaaran Narmada ke rift (darar) ke dono taraf statey hain. Exam point: 'Vindhya-Satpura = block mountains (faulting se)'.

qe: Which type of mass movement frequently blocks highways in the young Himalayas during heavy monsoon rains?
qh: बारिश के बाद कौन सा 'वृहत संचलन' हिमालयी राजमार्गों को अवरुद्ध करने का मुख्य कारण बनता है?
e: Concept: Himalaya abhi bhi 'young' pahaad hain - yahan mitti khokhli, dhalan tez, aur monsoon me lagatar barish se maate (mudslide) asaan hoti hai. Isliye monsoon ke samay pahaadi rajkimaarg (highways) par bade 'landslide / debris slide' aate hain, jinme mitti-patthar ke saath paani ke kaaran poora chat (slope) ek saath kheesak jata hai aur sadken din-bhar ke liye band ho jati hain (jaise Char Dham route). Solifluction thanda ilake ki dheemi kriya hai, isliye sahi jawab landslide hai. Exam point: 'Himalaya me monsoon me highways band = landslide/debris slide'.

qe: The 'Grand Canyon' in Arizona, USA, was carved over millions of years by which river?
qh: अमेरिका में 'ग्रैंड कैनियन' का निर्माण किस नदी द्वारा किया गया था?
e: Concept: Grand Canyon (Arizona, USA) duniya me sabse mashhoor ghati (gorge) hai, jahan 'Colorado River' ne lakhon saal lagatar pahaad ko kaat kar lagbhag 1.6 km gehra daraar banaya. Isse river erosion ka sabse bada saboot milta hai. Mississippi, Nile aur Amazon apne ilake ki badi nadiyan hain par Grand Canyon se nahi jode jate - Mississippi Gulf me, Nile Egypt me, Amazon Brazil me hai. Isliye answer Colorado river. Exam point: 'Grand Canyon = Colorado River ne banaya'.

qe: Standard Time adopted by a country is designed to ensure:
qh: किसी देश का 'मानक समय' क्या सुनिश्चित करता है?
o: Uniformity of civil time across all regions of the country
Different local times in every municipal corporation
e: Concept: Duniya ke desh ek hi samay (standard time) rakhne ka faisla isliye lete hain ki unke poore kshetra me ek hi ghadi chale - nahi to train, aeroplane aur office ke samay me hamesha confusion rahega. Isi liye kisi desh ka 'Standard Meridian' chun kar uske time ko 'Standard Time' maana jata hai - sun ke utar-chadhav se hone wala local time chahe alag rahe, civil time ek ho. Isse daylight nahi badhta aur elevation ka bhi koi sambandh nahi. Exam point: 'Standard Time = poore desh me ek jaisa civil samay (uniformity)'.

qe: The 'Guangxi' region in southern China is globally renowned for which geological landform?
qh: चीन का 'गुआंग्शी' (Guangxi) क्षेत्र किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Concept: 'Tower karst' yaani louhy (limestone) ki unchi, tekoni (steep-sided) minar jaisi pahaadiyan, ek aisi dhaancha jo lambi tez barish se limestone ghulne ke baad alag-alag tower ki shakal me bach jati hai. Duniya me sabse mashhoor tower karst ilaka 'Guangxi' (southern China), Guilin jaisa, hai - isliye wahan 'Guilin Landscape' famous hai. Glacial U-valleys, trenches aur barchan dunes alag landforms hain. Exam point: 'Guangxi = tower karst (limestone minar) ka ilaka'.

qe: The 'Deccan Traps' of Peninsular India were formed by which type of volcanic activity?
qh: 'दक्कन ट्रैप' का निर्माण किस प्रकार की ज्वालामुखी गतिविधि से हुआ था?
e: Concept: Deccan Traps (Peninsular India ka plateau) duniya ke sabse bade 'flood basalt' ilake me aata hai - yahan lakhon-saikdon square km lava phat kar faila hai, kyunki eruption fissure (daraar) se hua tha, kisi ek volcano ke munh se nahi. Aise eruption me bahut patla lava lambe ilake tak fail jata hai; isko 'fissure-fed flood basalt province' kehte hain. Cinder cone ya caldera bade explosions ke hote hain, par Deccan me aisa nahi hua. Exam point: 'Deccan Traps = fissure-fed flood basalt'.

qe: Where is the northernmost point of Indian-administered territory, known as 'Indira Col', located?
qh: भारत का सबसे उत्तरी बिंदु 'इंदिरा कोल' कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Concept: Bharat ke kshetra ke sabse uttar ka bindu 'Indira Col' hai, jo Ladakh ke Siachen Glacier ke paas, Karakoram pahaad wale ilake me padta hai - yahan se aage Pakistan/China ka kshetra (Siachen-Karakoram) hai. Aksai Chin aur Siachen par Bharat ka daava hai isliye geography me ise 'northernmost point of Indian-administered territory' likha jata hai. Kanyakumari south me hai, Andaman east-south me. Exam point: 'Indira Col = Siachen/Karakoram (sabse uttar ka bindu)'.

qe: The picturesque 'Chandratal' in Spiti, Himachal Pradesh, is an example of which glacial landform?
qh: हिमाचल प्रदेश की 'चंद्रताल' झील किस प्रकार की भू-आकृति का उदाहरण है?
e: Concept: Glacier jab pahaad ke 'cirque' (katori jaisi jagah) ko khodta hai, to uske astitv ke baad wahi katori paani se bhar jati hai - is aisi tavari (glacial) jheel ko 'Tarn' kehte hain. Chandratal (Spiti, Himachal) isi tarah ka tarn lake hai, aur pagadi wali 'lassi' (gol) shakal me chamakta hai. Ox-bow lake nadi ke mudne se banti hai, lagoon samudra ke paas, delta nadi ke munh par - sab alag hain. Exam point: 'Chandratal = tarn lake (cirque lake, glacier se bani jheel)'.

qe: Which minor tectonic plate is situated between the Pacific Plate and the South American Plate?
qh: प्रशांत और दक्षिण अमेरिकी प्लेटों के बीच कौन सी छोटी प्लेट स्थित है?
e: Concept: Duniya ki dharan (crust) kai badi aur chhoti 'plates' ki bani hai. 'Nazca Plate' ek chhoti samudri plate hai jo dakshin America ke pashchim me hai - is ke pashchim me Pacific Plate hai aur is ke purb (east) me South American Plate hai. Nazca plate South American plate ke neeche sarak kar Andes pahaad aur Peru-Chile trench bana rahi hai. Cocos, Juan de Fuca aur Arabian plates doosri jagah hain. Exam point: 'Pacific aur South American plate ke beech wali plate = Nazca'.

qe: Which physical process formed the vast alluvial fans along the Bhabar belt at the foot of the Himalayas?
qh: हिमालय की तलहटी में विशाल जलोढ़ पंखे किस भू-आकृतिक कारक द्वारा निर्मित हुए हैं?
e: Concept: Himalaya se nikalne wali nadiyan jab maidan me aati hain to unki raftaar achanak kam ho jati hai, isliye pahaadon se laye huye kankar, ret (gravel) phat kar fan (pankha) ki shakal me zameen par fail jaate hain - ise 'alluvial fan' kehte hain, aur ye Bhabar belt (Himalaya ke neeche) me bahut dikhta hai. Karan hai 'running water' (bahata paani) ka deposition (failav), koi glacier ya hawa nahi; isliye ye fluvial (nadi) landform hai. Exam point: 'Bhabar ke alluvial fans = fluvial deposition (nadi se)'.

qe: The lower deltaic region of the Ganga-Brahmaputra basin is famous for which ecosystem?
qh: 'गंगा डेल्टा' किस प्रकार के वनों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
e: Concept: Ganga-Brahmaputra ke delta (muhana) wale ilake me samudra ka khara paani aur nadi ka meeta paani milta hai, jahan khaas 'mangrove' (samudri khaar wale ped) uste hain - inhe tidal forests kehte hain. Bharat-Bangladesh ke is ilake ko 'Sundarbans' kaha jata hai, aur yahin Royal Bengal Tiger rehta hai. Alpine meadows thandi unchaai par, thorn scrub sookhe ilake me, coniferous hote hain - mangroves samudri kinare wale delta me. Exam point: 'Ganga-Brahmaputra delta ka ecosystem = mangrove (Sundarbans)'.

qe: In India, 'Laterite Soil' typically develops under which climatic conditions?
qh: भारत में 'लैटेराइट मृदा' किन परिस्थितियों में विकसित होती है?
o: Regions of high temperature and alternating intense wet and dry spells with heavy leaching
e: Concept: Laterite mitti un ilake me banti hai jahan bahut garmi ho aur saal me ek baar tez barish (baad) ho - barish mitti ke tatva (silica, lime) ko paani ke saath neeche baha deti hai (leaching), aur lohe-aluminium ke oxide bach jate hain, jisse mitti laal-bhoori aur sakht (brick jaisi) ho jati hai. Isi liye laterite mitti Kerala, Karnataka ke malabar ilake, Odisha aur 'laterite' brick (Patthar) ke liye famous hai. sookhe desert ya permafrost me ye nahi banti. Exam point: 'Laterite = high temp + alternate wet-dry + leaching'.

qe: The 'Ten Degree Channel' (10° N Latitude) separates which two island territories?
qh: 'दस डिग्री चैनल' किन दो द्वीप समूहों को अलग करता है?
e: Concept: Andaman-Nicobar group ko do hisson me baantne wali jal-sandhi 'Ten Degree Channel' hai - ye theek 10 degree North latitude par hai, isliye naam wahi pada. Iske uttar me Andaman Islands (Aur South, North, Middle, Little Andaman) aur dakshin me Nicobar (Car Nicobar, Great Nicobar) padte hain, aur sabse door 'Indira Point' (Great Nicobar) hai. Isliye ye channel Andaman aur Nicobar ko alag karta hai, Bharat-Sri Lanka ko nahi (wo Palk Strait karta hai). Exam point: 'Ten Degree Channel = Andaman aur Nicobar ke beech (10 degreeN)'.

qe: Where is 'Saddle Peak' (732 m), the highest summit of the Andaman and Nicobar Islands, situated?
qh: अंडमान और निकोबार द्वीप समूह की सबसे ऊँची चोटी 'सैडल पीक' कहाँ स्थित है?
e: Concept: Saddle Peak (732 m) Andaman-Nicobar ke sabse unche point hai, aur wo 'North Andaman' island par sthit hai - is area me sarvottam unchaai waale pahaad milte hain. Iske paas hi Saddle Peak National Park bhi hai. Cote hai ki Andaman me zyada unchaai wale pahaad nahi hain (maximum ~700-732 m), jabki Himalaya me hazaaron metre. Isliye Great Nicobar ya Little Andaman galat hain. Exam point: 'Saddle Peak = North Andaman (732 m)'.

qe: Which boundary line demarcates the border between India and Pakistan established in 1947?
qh: भारत और पाकिस्तान के बीच 1947 में निर्धारित सीमा रेखा कौन सी है?
e: Concept: 'Radcliffe Line' wo seema hai jo Britain ke vakil Sir Cyril Radcliffe ne 1947 me khinchi thi - ye Bharat (India) aur Pakistan (aur aaj Bangladesh wala hissa) ko baant-ti hai. Isliye 'India-Pakistan border' ke liye Radcliffe Line ka naam aata hai. Doosri lines yaad rakho: Durand Line (Afghanistan-Pakistan), McMahon Line (Bharat-China, Arunachal), LOC/RAD (Kashmir), Maginot Line (France-Germany, Europe me). Exam point: 'Bharat-Pakistan (1947) ki seema = Radcliffe Line'.

qe: Which line of latitude marks the Equator, dividing Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres?
qh: पृथ्वी को उत्तरी और दक्षिणी गोलार्धों में विभाजित करने वाला 0° अक्षांश क्या कहलाता है?
e: Concept: Prithvi ko do barabar hisson me baantne wali kalpnika (imaginary) rekha ko 'Equator' (bhumi-madhya rekha) kehte hain - ye 0 degree latitude par hoti hai aur duniya ko Northern (uttar) aur Southern (dakshin) Hemisphere me seinte hai. Ye giraffe ke gardan jaisa circle hai jo Beech (middle) se guzarta hai - kuch deshon (Ecuador, Kenya, Indonesia) se hoke jaata hai. Tropic of Cancer 23.5 degree N hai, Tropic of Capricorn 23.5 degree S - ye baad me aate hain. Exam point: '0 degree latitude = Equator (do hemisphere me baantta hai)'.

qe: The British Royal Observatory, serving as the benchmark for the Prime Meridian (0° Longitude), is located in:
qh: 'प्रधान याम्योत्तर' (0° देशांतर) किस स्थान की वेधशाला से होकर गुजरती है?
e: Concept: 'Prime Meridian' yaani 0 degree longitude wali line 'Greenwich' (London ke paas, Royal Observatory) se guzarti hai - 1884 ke international sammelan me isi jagah ko 0 degree maana gaya tha kyunki us waqt Britain duniya ka bada samudri desh tha. Isi wajah se duniya bhar ka time isi line se gina jata hai (GMT/BST). Isse pashchim ya poorab 'East/West longitude' badhta hai, aur IST (+5:30) bhi isi se jodte hain. Exam point: 'Prime Meridian 0 degree = Greenwich (London)'.

qe: If it is 12:00 PM (Noon) at Greenwich (0° Longitude), what is the Standard Time in India (82.5° E)?
qh: यदि ग्रीनविच (0°) पर दोपहर के 12:00 बजे हैं, तो भारत (82.5° E) में मानक समय क्या होगा?
e: Concept: GMT (Greenwich Mean Time) aur IST me 5 ghante 30 minute ka farq hai, kyunki Bharat ka standard meridian 82.5 degreeE par hai aur har 1 degree ke liye 4 minute jodna padta hai: 82.5 x 4 = 330 minute = 5:30. Isliye jab Greenwich (0 degree) me dopahar 12:00 baje hain, to Bharat me 12:00 + 5:30 = shaam 5:30 baje honge. Ye sawal time ke 'longitude' sambandh ka sabse aasan tarika hai - sabse pehle 82.5x4 karo, phir jod do. Exam point: '12:00 GMT = 5:30 PM IST'.

qe: Between which two mountain systems is the high-altitude cold desert of Ladakh located?
qh: 'लद्दाख' क्षेत्र किन दो प्रमुख पर्वत श्रृंखलाओं के मध्य स्थित है?
o: Karakoram Range to the north and Zanskar Range to the south
e: Concept: Ladakh ka thanda veer (cold desert) Himalayas me do parallel pahaadon ke beech me hai - uttar me 'Karakoram Range' aur dakshin me 'Zanskar Range'. In unchi divaaron ke beech hone ke kaaran monsoon ki nami wali hawaen wahan pahunch nahi paati, isliye wahan barish/barg (snow) bahut kam hoti hai aur zameen sookhi (cold desert) rehti hai. Isi wajah se Ladakh me ung (snow leopard), yak aur pashmina baali (goat) milte hain. Exam point: 'Ladakh cold desert = Karakoram (N) + Zanskar (S) ke beech'.

qe: Why was Sakchi (now Jamshedpur) selected by Jamsetji Tata to establish TISCO in 1907?
qh: 1907 में टिस्को (TISCO) की स्थापना के लिए साकची (जमशेदपुर) को क्यों चुना गया था?
o: Proximity to an international seaport in Bihar
Gold mines in the surrounding hills
Proximity to iron ore (Mayurbhanj), coal (Jharia), limestone, and perennial water from Subarnarekha-Kharkai
e: Concept: Jamsetji Tata ne 1907 me TISCO ka paanta Sakchi (aaj Jamshedpur) me isliye laga kyunki wahan loha-ayask (iron ore) Mayurbhanj/Noamundi se nazdeek tha, koyla (coal) Jharia se aata tha, limestone paas hi thi, aur Subarnarekha-Kharkai nadiyon ka saal bhar behne wala paani mill ke liye maujood tha. Isi wajah se aaj bhi Jamshedpur 'Steel City' kehlata hai - matlab yahi mineral + water ka combination Tata ko khinch laaya. Exam point: 'Jamshedpur (TISCO) = iron ore + coal + water (Subarnarekha-Kharkai) ke kareeb'.

qe: What is the exact latitudinal extent of the mainland of India?
qh: भारत की मुख्य भूमि का अक्षांशीय विस्तार क्या है?
e: Concept: Bharat ka mainland (mukhya bhoomi) north se south tak 8 degree4' North se 37 degree6' North latitude ke beech faila hua hai - matlab lagbhag 29 degree ka antar (3214 km). Isliye yahan uttar me Kashmir ki barf se lekar dakshin (Kanyakumari) ki garmi tak sab mahaul milte hain. Yaad rakhein: latitude = N-8 degree4' se N-37 degree6'; longitude = E-68 degree7' se E-97 degree25'. Poora desh (Andaman-Nicobar ke saath) 6 degree4' N se 37 degree6' N tak hai. Exam point: 'Mainland India: 8 degree4'N se 37 degree6'N latitudes'.

qe: Which was the southernmost point of the Indian Union territory before getting submerged during the 2004 Tsunami?
qh: भारतीय संघ का सबसे दक्षिणी बिंदु कौन सा था, जो 2004 की सुनामी में जलमग्न हो गया था?
e: Concept: 'Indira Point' Great Nicobar island ka dakshin sira tha jo Bharat ka sabse dakshin bindu (union territory) maana jata tha - 2004 ki tsunami me iska bada hissa samudra me doob gaya. Isliye sawal me 'before 2004 tsunami' likha hota hai, jawab Indira Point. Kanyakumari mainland ka sabse dakshin bindu hai, par union territory me Indira Point pehle sabse neeche tha. Aaj bhi ye Bharat ke samudri kshetra ka ahem point hai. Exam point: '2004 tsunami se pehle sabse dakshin point = Indira Point (Great Nicobar)'.

qe: Which Indian state contains the easternmost point of the nation (Kibithu at 97°25' E)?
qh: भारत का सबसे पूर्वी छोर (किबिथू, 97°25' E) किस राज्य में स्थित है?
e: Concept: Bharat ka sabse purab (easternmost) bindu 'Kibithu' hai, jo Arunachal Pradesh ke Anjaw zile me 97 degree25' E par padta hai - isi wajah se Arunachal ko 'Udayachal' (suraj ugne wala pahaad) bhi kehte hain, kyunki Bharat me sabse pehle yahin sooraj ugta hai. Iske aas-paas China-Myanmar ki seema bhi lagti hai. Rajasthan ka pashchim bindu (Gujarat ke paas) sabse pashchim par hai - isliye poore desh me 2 ghante ka sanskritik samay antar dikhta hai. Exam point: 'Easternmost point = Kibithu (Arunachal Pradesh)'.

qe: What body of water separates the Indian subcontinent from the island nation of Sri Lanka?
qh: कौन सा समुद्री चैनल भारत को श्रीलंका से अलग करता है?
o: Palk Strait and Gulf of Mannar
e: Concept: Bharat aur Sri Lanka ke beech judne wala samudri hissa do hisson me bata jata hai - 'Palk Strait' (Palk jal-sandhi, uttar me) aur 'Gulf of Mannar' (dakshin me). Isi bareek paani wale ilake me 'Adam's Bridge/Ram Setu' naam ke chhote chhote tal (shoal) hain jo Bharat ko Sri Lanka se lagbhag jode hue hain. Isliye ye dono Sri Lanka ko alag karte hain; Bering Strait (America-Russia), Sunda/Malacca (SE Asia) alag hain. Exam point: 'Bharat-Sri Lanka ke beech = Palk Strait + Gulf of Mannar'.

qe: What unique 'Floating National Park' is located on Loktak Lake in Manipur?
qh: मणिपुर की लोकतक झील पर तैरते हुए फुमडियों वाला कौन सा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान स्थित है?
e: Concept: 'Keibul Lamjao' Manipur ke Loktak jheel par sthit duniya ka ekmatra 'floating national park' hai - yahan paani par tairti (floating) fums (phumdi = organic phool) ki parat hoti hai jispar 'Sangai' (brow-antlered deer) chalta hai. Isliye ye 'tairta hua national park' kehlata hai. Jim Corbett, Kaziranga, Sundarbans zameen par ke park hain. Ye park 'Manipur ka gaurav' hai aur Sangai wahan ka rajya pashu (state animal) hai. Exam point: 'Floating national park = Keibul Lamjao (Loktak Lake, Manipur)'.

qe: The South-West Monsoon typically makes its initial landfall on the Indian mainland along which coast?
qh: दक्षिण-पश्चिम मानसून सामान्यतः जून के पहले सप्ताह में किस तट पर दस्तक देता है?
e: Concept: South-West Monsoon (garmiyon ki barish wali hawa) sabse pehle Bharat ke dakshin-pashchim kinare KERALA (Malabar coast) par pahunchti hai - lagbhag 1 June ko; isi wajah se Kerala me sabse pehle barish hoti hai aur wahan sabse lamba monsoon season (June se September) rehta hai. Ye hawaen Arabian Sea ke upar se aati hain aur pahaadon (Western Ghats) se takra kar wahi pehli bhaari barish deti hain. Bay of Bengal wali shakha baad me aati hai. Exam point: 'SW monsoon first landfall = Kerala/Malabar coast (~1 June)'.

qe: From which all-weather port in Karnataka is iron ore slurry from the Kudremukh mines exported?
qh: कर्नाटक की कुद्रेमुख खानों से लौह अयस्क का घोल (slurry) किस बंदरगाह से निर्यात किया जाता है?
e: Concept: Kudremukh (Karnataka) me loha-ayask (iron ore) ki khanan hoti thi, aur wahan se nikle ore ko paani me ghuma kar 'slurry' (keechad) bana kar pipeline se samudri bandargah tak bheja jata tha. Ye ore 'New Mangalore Port' (Karnataka) se videsh (Japan waghera) bheja jata tha - isliye jawab New Mangalore hai. Mormugao (Goa), Visakhapatnam (AP), Paradip (Odisha) doosre ports hain jahan se alag maal jaata hai. Exam point: 'Kudremukh ore = New Mangalore Port se export'.

qe: The 'Golden Quadrilateral' superhighway system connects which four metropolitan cities of India?
qh: 'स्वर्णिम चतुर्भुज' एक्सप्रेसवे परियोजना किन चार प्रमुख भारतीय महानगरों को जोड़ती है?
e: Concept: 'Golden Quadrilateral' Bharat ki 4 mahanagaron - Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai aur Kolkata - ko jodne wala chaar tarfa (quadrilateral) highway network hai, jiski lambai lagbhag 5,846 km hai; ise NHAI chalata hai. Iska maksad in chaar industrial-corridor shehron ke beech tez transport, kam samay aur kam fuel khapat hai. Baaki option list chhote-circuits (Delhi-Jaipur-Ahmedabad) ya dakshin ke sheher hain. Exam point: 'Golden Quadrilateral = Delhi-Mumbai-Chennai-Kolkata'.

qe: The 9.02 km long 'Atal Tunnel' beneath the Rohtang Pass connects which two areas year-round?
qh: रोहतांग दर्रे के नीचे बनी 'अटल टनल' किन दो क्षेत्रों को पूरे वर्ष जोड़े रखती है?
e: Concept: Atal Tunnel (9.02 km, duniya ka sabse lamba highway tunnel samudra tal se 10,000 feet upar) Rohtang Pass ke NEECHE se guzarta hai aur MANALI (Himachal) ko LAHAUL-SPITI ghati se jodta hai - isse pehle Rohtang par baraf ki wajah se 6 mahine band rehta tha, ab saal bhar raasta khula rehta hai. Isse army ko bhi Labah-Ladakh tak pahunchne me fayda hai. Srinagar-Leh ya Dehradun-Mussoorie alag raaste hain. Exam point: 'Atal Tunnel = Manali to Lahaul-Spiti (Rohtang ke neeche)'.

qe: National Waterway 1 (NW-1) operates along which river stretch in India?
qh: राष्ट्रीय जलमार्ग 1 (NW-1) किस नदी मार्ग पर संचालित है?
o: Ganga-Bhagirathi-Hooghly system from Prayagraj to Haldia
West Coast Canal from Kottapuram to Kollam
e: Concept: National Waterway 1 (NW-1) Ganga nadi ka woh hissa hai jo Prayagraj se Haldia tak jata hai (lagbhag 1620 km) - isme Ganga, Bhagirathi aur Hooghly nadiyan shamil hain aur ye Bharat ka sabse bada antar-jaliya (inland water) transport maarg hai (Jal Marg Vikas ke tehat). Isse Varanasi se Haldia tak sasta maal (coal, khada khaad, container) bheja jata hai. NW-2 Brahmaputra, NW-3 West Coast Canal alag hain. Exam point: 'NW-1 = Ganga (Prayagraj se Haldia tak)'.

qe: The tectonic 'San Andreas Fault' in California represents which type of plate margin?
qh: 'सैन एंड्रियास फॉल्ट' किस प्रकार की प्लेट सीमा का एक प्रमुख उदाहरण है?
e: Concept: San Andreas Fault California me hai aur yahan Pacific Plate, North American Plate ke SAATH-SATH (parallel) sarak rahi hai - ek plate doosri ke neeche nahi ja rahi, isliye yahan 'transform' (strike-slip) margin hai jahan bhukamp aate hain par jaalamukhi (volcano) nahi. Iske ulta convergent margin me plates takrati hain, divergent me hat-ti hain, aur hotspot chain Hawaii jaisa hota hai. Exam point: 'San Andreas Fault = transform (strike-slip) plate boundary'.

qe: The 'Llanos' and 'Campos' tropical savanna grasslands are located in which continent?
qh: 'लानोस' और 'कंपोस' उष्णकटिबंधीय सवाना घास के मैदान किस महाद्वीप में स्थित हैं?
e: Concept: Grasslands ke naam har mahadeep me alag hain - South America me tropical savanna ko 'Llanos' (Venezuela/Colombia) aur 'Campos' (Brazil) kehte hain; Africa me savanna (acacia) aur high veld hai, Australia me downs, North America me prairies. Isliye Llanos aur Campos South America ke saavanna grasslands hain; ye garm, ghaas wale ilake hain jahan mausami barish hoti hai. Exam point: 'Llanos + Campos = South America ke savanna grasslands'.

qe: The hyper-arid Atacama Desert in South America owes its extreme dryness partly to which cold ocean current?
qh: दक्षिण अमेरिका के अटाकामा मरुस्थल की अत्यधिक शुष्कता के लिए कौन सी ठंडी समुद्री धारा उत्तरदायी है?
e: Concept: Atacama Desert (Chile) duniya ka sabse sookha registan maana jata hai, aur isi wajah se yahan kuch jagah to saikdon saal barish nahi hoti. Iska ek bada kaaran hai 'Humboldt Current' (Peru Current) - Pacific se aati thandi samudri dhaara, jo apne saath nami wali hawaon ko thanda karke barish se pehle hi rok deti hai (hawa me bhaap nahi, kondan), aur Andes ke pahaad bhi (rainshadow) rok lene deti hain. Exam point: 'Atacama ki sookhi = Humboldt (Peru) cold current'.

qe: Which cold mid-latitude desert lies in the rainshadow of the southern Andes Mountains?
qh: दक्षिणी एंडीज पर्वतमाला की वृष्टि-छाया में स्थित शीतोष्ण मरुस्थल कौन सा है?
e: Concept: 'Patagonian desert' Chile-Argentina ke dakshin hissa me hai. Yahan Andes ke pahaad (west se aati) nami wali hawaon ko rok lete hain, isliye pahaadon ke door wale (leeside) ilake me barish nahi hoti - isi ko 'rainshadow desert' kehte hain. Iske ulta Atacama bhi raan aisa hai par wo sagar ki thandi dhara se bhi juda hai; yahaan sawal 'southern Andes ko rain-shadow' ka hai. Kalahari Africa me hai, Mojave north America me. Exam point: 'Southern Andes ke rain-shadow wala desert = Patagonian'.

qe: The 'Chaparral' sclerophyllous scrub biome is characteristic of which Mediterranean climate region?
qh: 'चपल' (Chaparral) झाड़ीदार वनस्पति किस भूमध्यसागरीय क्षेत्र की विशिष्ट पहचान है?
e: Concept: 'Chaparral' ek ghana, sakht patte wali (sclerophyll) jhaadi wala biome hai jo 'Mediterranean climate' me hota hai - garm sookhi garmi aur halki baarish wali sardi, isliye yahan taink patte wale ped aur jhaadiyan hoti hain (oak, olive jaisa). Duniya me Mediterranean climate 5 jagah hai: Mediterranean basin, California (USA), Central Chile, Western Cape (South Africa) aur SW Australia. Chaparral naam khaas California ke coastal ilake ka hai. Exam point: 'Chaparral = Coastal California (Mediterranean scrub)'.

qe: The 'Murray-Darling' agricultural basin is situated within which temperate grassland realm?
qh: 'मरे-डार्लिंग' कृषि बेसिन किस महाद्वीप के शीतोष्ण घास के मैदानों में स्थित है?
e: Concept: 'Murray-Darling basin' Australia ka sabse bada kheti ka ilaka hai - Murray aur Darling nadion ka dhara jahan wheat, chawal, kapas aur angur (wine) ki kheti hoti hai. Ye 'Downs' (Australia ke temperate grassland) ilake me padta hai, jo duniya ke 'granaries' me ginta hai. Prairies North America me, Pampas Argentina me, Veld South Africa me hai. Isliye Murray-Darling = Downs of Australia. Exam point: 'Murray-Darling basin = Australia (Downs grassland)'.

qe: What characterizes the fertile 'Pampas' biome of Argentina and Uruguay?
qh: अर्जेंटीना के 'पंपास' (Pampas) घास के मैदानों की मुख्य विशेषता क्या है?
o: Deep, rich temperate grasslands renowned for intensive wheat cultivation and commercial cattle ranching
e: Concept: 'Pampas' Argentina aur Uruguay ka bada samtal ghans ka maidan hai. Yahan ki mitti gehri, upjau aur kaali hai, isliye yahan bade paimane par GEHUN ki kheti hoti hai aur paashu (cattle, bhed) paal kar gaala (meat) aur oon (wool) videsh bhejte hain - 'cowboys' ko yahan 'gauchos' kehte hain. Equatorial rainforest nahi, na permafrost - Pampas temperate grassland hai. Exam point: 'Pampas = Argentina-Uruguay ka wheat + cattle grassland'.

qe: Which cold oceanic current off the northwestern coast of Africa reinforces the aridity of the Sahara Desert?
qh: उत्तर-पश्चिमी अफ्रीका के तट पर बहने वाली कौन सी ठंडी समुद्री धारा सहारा मरुस्थल की शुष्कता को बढ़ाती है?
e: Concept: Sahara (North Africa) duniya ka sabse bada garm registan hai, aur uske pashchim kinare par 'Canary Current' bahati hai - ye ek THANDI samudri dhara hai jo dhuan nami wali hawaon ko thanda kar deti hai, isliye barish se pehle hi nami jal jaati hai aur kinare ka ilaka sookha (registan) rehta hai. Agulhas (warm), Benguela (thandi, Africa ke dakshin-pashchim), Somali (warm) alag hain. Exam point: 'Sahara ki sookhi me Canary Current (thandi dhara) ka role'.

qe: Which major warm ocean current transports tropical Gulf of Mexico waters northeastward across the North Atlantic toward Europe?
qh: मेक्सिको की खाड़ी से उत्तर-पूर्व की ओर यूरोप की तरफ बहने वाली प्रसिद्ध गर्म जलधारा कौन सी है?
e: Concept: 'Gulf Stream' ek garm samudri dhara hai jo Mexico ki khadi (Gulf of Mexico) se shuru hokar Florida ke paas se uttar-purab ki taraf chalti hai aur North Atlantic ko cross karke Europe (Britain, Norway) tak pahunchti hai. Garm paani ke saath ye garmi (heat) le jaati hai, isliye Europe ki sardi utni kadak nahi hoti jitni uske latitude par honi chahiye - isse Europe ka mausam 'temperate' rehta hai. Kuroshio (Japan), Oyashio (thandi), Canary (thandi) alag hain. Exam point: 'Warm current Gulf of Mexico se Europe = Gulf Stream'.

qe: The 'Sargasso Sea' in the North Atlantic Ocean is unique globally because it:
qh: उत्तरी अटलांटिक में स्थित 'सारगासो सागर' अद्वितीय क्यों है?
o: Remains frozen into pack ice year-round
Has a freshwater layer on the surface
Is an open-ocean sea bounded entirely by circular ocean currents (gyre) with no terrestrial shorelines
Is the deepest trench on Earth
e: Concept: 'Sargasso Sea' North Atlantic Ocean ka woh hissa hai jise kisi zameen ne nahi, balki chaaron taraf ki samudri dharaon ne gher rakha hai - North Atlantic Gyre. Isi wajah se ye 'open-ocean sea' hai jiski koi kinara (shoreline) nahi; iski khaas baat hain tairti hui sagar (seaweed, sargassum) aur Europe ki eel (machhli) yahin ande dene aati hai. Ye sabse gehra trench nahi (Challenger Deep to Pacific me hai). Exam point: 'Sargasso Sea = dharaon (gyre) se ghira, koi kinara nahi'.

qe: Which cold current flows southward from the Arctic into the western North Pacific, meeting the warm Kuroshio Current?
qh: उत्तरी प्रशांत महासागर में उत्तर से दक्षिण की ओर बहने वाली ठंडी जलधारा कौन सी है जो कुरोशियो से मिलती है?
e: Concept: Japan ke samudri ilake me do dharaen milti hain - dakshin se aane wali GARAM 'Kuroshio' (black current) aur uttar (Arctic/Okhotsk) se aane wali THANDI 'Oyashio' (Kuril current). Dono ke milan ki jagah (convergence) me paani ke tatva milte hain, isliye yahan duniya ki sabse acchi machhli pakad (fishing grounds) banti hai - Japan ki machhli industry isi par khadi hai. California, East Australian, Peru currents doosre ilake ke hain. Exam point: 'Oyashio (thandi) + Kuroshio (garam) = Japan ke paas milti hain'.

qe: Which Indian state was the first to make rooftop rainwater harvesting compulsory for every building?
qh: भारत का कौन सा राज्य प्रत्येक घर और इमारत के लिए छत वर्षा जल संचयन अनिवार्य करने वाला पहला राज्य बना?
e: Concept: Chatt par barish ka paani jama karke (rainwater harvesting) use karna sabse pehle Tamil Nadu rajya ne sabhi buildings ke liye anivarya (compulsory) kar diya tha - iske peechhe yahi soch thi ki sookhe aur ghatte pani wale ilake me zameen ke andar pani (groundwater) badhe aur sepidy (flood) na ho. Isi wajah se Chennai me aaj bhi purane gharon me chhat wale tank dikhate hain. Rajasthan me tanka/khadeen parampara hai par compulsory law Tamil Nadu ne banaya. Exam point: 'Rooftop rainwater harvesting compulsory karne wala pehla rajya = Tamil Nadu'.

qe: The multipurpose 'Hirakud Dam' project is constructed across which major river basin?
qh: विशाल 'हीराकुंड बांध' किस नदी पर निर्मित है?
e: Concept: 'Hirakud Dam' Odisha me MAHANADI nadi par bana Bharat ka sabse lamba mitti ka bandh (earthen dam) hai (lagbhag 26 km lamba, duniya ke sabse lambe dams me ginta hai). Ye Mahanadi delta (Cuttack-Odisha ke kheti) ke ilake me paani deta hai, bijli banata hai aur baad se bachata hai. Ganga, Godavari aur Sutlej ke dams alag naam se hain (Bhakra-Sutlej par, Sardar Sarovar Narmada par). Exam point: 'Hirakud = Mahanadi nadi par (Odisha)'.

qe: Why does Delhi experience greater annual and diurnal temperature extremes compared to coastal Mumbai?
qh: तटीय शहर मुंबई की तुलना में दिल्ली में अत्यधिक तापांतर (गर्मियों में ज्यादा गर्मी और सर्दियों में ज्यादा ठंड) क्यों होता है?
o: Mumbai is located directly on the Tropic of Cancer
Delhi is landlocked and subject to continentality, while Mumbai experiences maritime temperature moderation from the Arabian Sea
Mumbai is situated on a high mountain plateau
Delhi receives higher cloud cover across all seasons
e: Concept: Delhi samudra se door (landlocked) hai, isliye yahan 'continentality' ka asar hota hai - garmi me bahut garam aur sardi me bahut thanda. Ulta Mumbai samudra ke kinare hai, jahan paani ki moti parat (ocean) garmi-ju-sardi ko sanjota (moderate) rakhti hai, isliye wahan itna tez temperature antar nahi hota. Isi wajah se Delhi ka daily (diurnal) aur annual temperature range Mumbai se bahut zyada hota hai - yahi 'maritime vs continental' fark hai. Exam point: 'Delhi me zyada temperature antar = continentality; Mumbai = maritime moderation'.

qe: What causes the approximate two-hour local solar time difference between western Gujarat and eastern Arunachal Pradesh?
qh: पश्चिमी गुजरात और पूर्वी अरुणाचल प्रदेश के स्थानीय सूर्य समय में लगभग दो घंटे का अंतर किस कारण से होता है?
o: Longitudinal span of approximately 30 degrees (30° × 4 minutes = 120 minutes)
e: Concept: Bharat ek hi standard time rakhta hai, par uska purab-pashchim failav 68 degree7' E se 97 degree25' E tak lagbhag 30 degree ka hai. Chunki duniya 24 ghante me 360 degree ghumti hai, har 1 degree longitude par samay 4 minute badalta hai - isliye 30 degree x 4 minute = 120 minute = 2 ghante ka farq aata hai. Isliye jab Gujarat me (pashchim) sooraj baad me ugta hai to Arunachal (purab) me do ghante pehle uga chuka hota hai. Exam point: 'Gujarat-Arunachal me 2 ghante ka antar = 30 degree longitude x 4 min'.
